concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 measures the proportion of root phenotype datasets successfully merged with soil nutrient data, but the plan records Amendment AM-001 (T009) that explicitly excludes FR-002 (soil merge) and FR-003 (KNN imputation). Consequently, SC-001 will inevitably be 0 or marked as failed by definition, making the validation of this criterion circular and non‑informative.
